about: The trained models of AegisPilot ML (JSON forests, read by the Python standard library only: ml/forest.py). They are not in the repository: `guard_cli.py ml-install` downloads them from the GitHub release below and refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs. The guard checks the hashes again before each run.

full.review_rule: alert and a code behavior signal (a SEVERE feature present, or another BEHAVIOR feature present with a positive SHAP contribution); an alert without one is a note

meta.review_rule: score >= review; alert <= score < review is a note

trained.algorithm: random forest (scikit-learn 1.9.1, 300 trees, min_samples_leaf=2), converted to JSON (ml/convert.py)
trained.age_definition: age_days = log1p(floor((scan time UTC - first upload of the project) / 1 day)); files_latest is not used
trained.training_ages: new benign replicated at 0/1/3/7/14/30 days, malicious at 0..T (T = days to the report), weights 1/6
trained.threshold_rule: the lowest thresholds that meet every goal (all <= 5%, top <= 2%, longtail and new <= 8% false alarms) on 494 real-condition benign packages at install ages 0-30 days, rounded up to 4 decimals
trained.final_check: independent 650 benign (2026-11-05; new 250, longtail 250, top 150), worst install age (same day), REVIEW: all 2.0%, new 4.0%, longtail 0.8%, top 0.7%
